title: Resume token acquisition without legacy redirect members
goal: Migrate custom AccessTokenResult producers and WASM consumers together, preserving successful token handling and interactive scopes, return location and navigation state.

selectionNotes: Only the IAccessTokenProvider boundary is controlled; the matching WASM runtime and NavigationManager execute in Chromium. No external provider, issued token, authorized API response or downloaded recording is claimed.
Use TryGetToken before RequiresRedirect; successful results need no navigation. A current interactive result needs both InteractiveRequestUrl and InteractionOptions.

constraints: Only the IAccessTokenProvider boundary is controlled; the matching WASM runtime and NavigationManager execute in Chromium. No external provider, issued token, authorized API response or downloaded recording is claimed.
Use TryGetToken before RequiresRedirect; successful results need no navigation. A current interactive result needs both InteractiveRequestUrl and InteractionOptions.
ReturnUrl is constructed from a fixed application-owned route and checked against BaseUri. Do not accept an unvalidated external or query-supplied return location.
.NET 10 parameterless Redirect reads legacy RedirectUrl when options are absent. A four-argument no-options result has no legacy URL and fails; RC2 reads the result's InteractiveRequestUrl instead.
Redirect(Action<InteractiveRequestOptions>) requires actual options; do not use it for a no-options result. Existing exception signatures remain unchanged.
stabilityLimitations: Public APIs are not marked experimental in the inspected assets. Evidence is RC2 only; GA reconciliation and comprehensive publication gates remain open. No unsupported older-target route is advertised.
